title: Cutout (2 parts)
spec:
Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and translation vector also set to zero. In this system, draw a two-dimensional sketch on a new face. The sketch consists of a closed loop made up of four lines: the first line starts at the origin and ends at (0.0462, 0.0), the second line starts at (0.0462, 0.0) and ends at (0.0462, 0.75), the third line starts at (0.0462, 0.75) and ends at (0.0, 0.75), and the fourth line completes the loop by connecting (0.0, 0.75) back to the origin. Apply a scale factor of 0.75 to the entire sketch. Transform the scaled sketch into three dimensions by rotating it with Euler angles set to zero and translating it with a vector also set to zero. Extrude the sketch 0.0231 units along the normal direction to create a solid body. The final dimensions of this rectangular base are length 0.04615384615384615, width 0.75, and height 0.023076923076923078.

For the second part, create another coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector of [0.0115, 0.0115, 0.0231]. On a new face, draw a closed loop consisting of four lines: the first line starts at the origin and ends at (0.0231, 0.0), the second line starts at (0.0231, 0.0) and ends at (0.0231, 0.7269), the third line starts at (0.0231, 0.7269) and ends at (0.0, 0.7269), and the fourth line completes the loop by connecting (0.0, 0.7269) back to the origin. Apply a scale factor of 0.7269 to the sketch. Transform the scaled sketch into three dimensions by rotating it with Euler angles set to zero and translating it with the specified vector. Extrude the sketch 0.0115 units in the opposite direction of the normal to remove material from the existing body. The final dimensions of this cutout are length 0.023076923076923075, width 0.7269230769230769, and height 0.011538461538461539.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Part 1
part_1 = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.0462, 0).lineTo(0.0462, 0.75).lineTo(0, 0.75).close().extrude(0.0231)

# Part 2
part_2 = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.0231, 0).lineTo(0.0231, 0.7269).lineTo(0, 0.7269).close().extrude(-0.0115)

# Translate part_2
part_2 = part_2.translate((0.0115, 0.0115, 0.0231))

# Combine the parts
r = part_1.cut(part_2)

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Outer dimensions
L = 0.7500   # length along Y
W = 0.0462   # width along X
H = 0.0231   # height along Z

# Recess (groove) parameters
wall = 0.005      # wall thickness around the groove
depth = 0.012     # depth of the groove from the top

# Build the outer block
outer = cq.Workplane("XY").box(W, L, H, centered=(True, True, False))

# Build the inner cut (recess along the full length, open at top)
inner = (
    cq.Workplane("XY", origin=(0, 0, H - depth))
    .box(W - 2 * wall, L - 2 * wall, depth + 0.01, centered=(True, True, False))
    .translate((0, 0, -0.005))
)

# Cut the groove
r = outer.cut(inner)

lanes.label: Kimi K3 (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Overall dimensions
W = 0.0462   # X width
L = 0.7500   # Y length
H = 0.0231   # Z height

# Top pocket (closed at both ends), centered on the bar
slot_w = 0.0302    # pocket width in X
slot_l = 0.7000    # pocket length in Y
slot_d = 0.0100    # pocket depth

# Base bar
r = cq.Workplane("XY").box(W, L, H, centered=(True, True, False))

# Cut the recessed longitudinal pocket into the top face
r = r.faces(">Z").workplane().center(0, 0).rect(slot_w, slot_l).cutBlind(-slot_d)
